Valmont depot: 62 vehicles, 140 drivers, 8 lifts, certified June 2023 (renewal due June 2028). Operations lead Halvard Onstad; night supervisor Teodora Blaskovic. Average 410 daily departures, winter peak 530; 1.8% cancellations. Night shift understaffed.

February 2025: brake line failure grounded nine vehicles four days; cause unestablished. Brake checks every 6000 km. September 2024: cloned fuel cards lost €4200. Parts store: 1100 line items; supplier contact Ingrid Solheim.

Open items: electrification study approved but unfunded; second charging bay due Q3; old ticketing terminals on three routes; winter peak capacity unmodelled. May 2026: duplicate roster left two shifts uncovered.

Key rules: fuel card second approval above €200; parts above €500 need two quotations; route changes need seven days' notice; incidents filed within 24 hours; roster needs one named publisher.
